questions.title: Biology — Photosynthesis
questions.prompt: Explain photosynthesis and mention its requirements.
questions.modelAnswer: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight and chlorophyll to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen.

questions.title: Physics — Newton's Second Law
questions.prompt: State Newton's second law and write its mathematical expression.
questions.modelAnswer: Newton's second law states that force is equal to mass multiplied by acceleration: F = ma.

questions.title: English — Water Conservation
questions.prompt: Explain why water conservation is important.
questions.modelAnswer: Water conservation protects freshwater resources, reduces shortages and supports people and ecosystems.
